# Makeself build dependency

This directory contains the unmodified `makeself.sh`, `makeself-header.sh`, and `COPYING` files from the [CANN makeself 2.5.0-patch1 source release](https://gitcode.com/cann-src-third-party/makeself/releases/download/release-2.5.0-patch1.0/makeself-release-2.5.0-patch1.tar.gz). The upstream archive SHA-256 is `bfa730a5763cdb267904a130e02b2e48e464986909c0733ff1c96495f620369a`.

The scripts are used by CPack to build the custom operator installer and are licensed under the GNU General Public License. See [COPYING](COPYING) and the copyright headers in the scripts.
